description: This file defines a server-side Next.js page component for rendering note details and supports static generation with fallback behavior.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Provides static parameters for Next.js static site generation. Returns an empty array indicating no pre-rendered params, allowing Next.js to fallback to client-side rendering.
